question: List the Name of all artists ordered alphabetically.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name ASC;

question: Show the Title of the top 5 longest tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all distinct genres.
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM Genre;

question: Show the FirstName and LastName of all customers from Brazil.
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: List the names of all playlists.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Playlist;

question: Find the email address of customer named Luís Gonçalves.
expected_sql: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Luís' AND LastName = 'Gonçalves';

question: Show the names of all media types.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType;

question: List the top 10 most expensive tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show all employees ordered by their HireDate.
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate FROM Employee ORDER BY HireDate ASC;

question: List the names of tracks longer than 5 minutes.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000;

question: Show the Title of albums created by the artist AC/DC.
expected_sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC';

question: List the Name of tracks and their genre.
expected_sql: SELECT Track.Name, Genre.Name FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId;

question: Find the customers who have placed invoices worth more than $10.
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.Total > 10;

question: Show all tracks that belong to the Rock genre.
expected_sql: SELECT Track.Name FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Rock';

question: List customer names and the total amount they spent.
expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName;

question: Find all tracks in the playlist named Music.
expected_sql: SELECT Track.Name FROM Track JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId WHERE Playlist.Name = 'Music';

question: Show the employee and the customers assigned to them.
expected_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId;

question: List the artists and the number of albums they have.
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name;

question: Find the countries with more than 5 customers.
expected_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(CustomerId) > 5;

question: Show the names of albums that contain more than 10 tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title HAVING COUNT(Track.TrackId) > 10;

question: Find the top 5 customers by total spending.
expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show the artist whose tracks generated the highest revenue.
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the genre with the highest number of purchases.
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalPurchased FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY TotalPurchased DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List customers who purchased tracks from more than 3 different genres.
expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3;

question: Find the total sales amount for each year.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS SalesYear, SUM(Total) AS TotalSales FROM Invoice GROUP BY SalesYear;

question: Show the most purchased track.
expected_sql: SELECT Track.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalPurchased FROM Track JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Track.TrackId, Track.Name ORDER BY TotalPurchased DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the average track price for each genre.
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, AVG(Track.UnitPrice) AS AvgPrice FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name;

question: List artists that have tracks in more than 2 playlists.
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId) > 2;

question: Show the country that generated the highest revenue.
expected_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find customers who never made a purchase.
expected_sql: SELECT Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName FROM Customer LEFT JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE Invoice.InvoiceId IS NULL;
